title: Write data-source compliance policy (open-only; controlled-access exclusion; COSMIC/OncoKB flagged)
context: M0 governance task for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. This policy is the binding data guardrail every downstream task inherits: open-access/aggregate/de-identified/simulated data ONLY; controlled-access and identifiable patient data are refused-and-flagged, not scheduled. It must be written before any data curation so the CI license gate and all curators have an authoritative reference. No partner is yet secured (verifiedNeed=false).
objective: Author the data-source compliance policy document defining in-scope vs out-of-scope sources, the refuse-and-flag rule, per-source license record fields, and the re-identifiability check gate that the CI license gate references.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy explicitly lists dbGaP, EGA, TARGET/TCGA controlled tiers, and individual-level biobanks as out of scope, with the refuse-and-flag rule.
TCGA/GDC open-tier and GEO documented as open; COSMIC and OncoKB documented as non-commercial/custom and reference-only, never redistributed/depended-on.
Defines the per-source license record fields and the re-identifiability check gate.
Reviewed by compliance reviewer and domain expert; CI license gate references it.
output: docs/COMPLIANCE.md — the data-source compliance policy referenced by the CI license/provenance gate.
